note: Baseline for the CI lint gate (scripts/lint-gate.mjs). These ceilings may only DECREASE. 'maxErrors' = total ESLint errors allowed; 'maxAny' = allowed '@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any' violations (freezes 'no new any'). Measured on the committed tree at HEAD. When you fix legacy lint debt, lower these numbers in the same PR. See docs/qa/etapa-0-rede-de-seguranca.md.
